attribution.note: Marcus directly states and endorses the architectural necessity claim.

semantics.note: The normalisation preserves the categorical necessity claim and the exclusion of approaches without neurosymbolic AI. No deadline or probabilistic hedge is supplied.

contract.note: The contract fairly operationalises the ordinary necessity claim. A successful neurosymbolic system cannot prove universal necessity; a validated AGI without neurosymbolic methods could disprove it. Definitional ambiguities do not determine this packet's result.

evidence.note: The dated benchmark evaluation supplies relevant capability evidence, but establishes neither broadly validated AGI nor an implementation independent of neurosymbolic methods.
The assessment documents unsettled AGI evaluation standards. Reported developer results and capabilities of a different system do not establish a counterexample or architectural necessity.
The dated preprint addresses narrower learning objectives and characterises some systems as neurosymbolic. It does not establish a broadly validated necessity result covering every route to AGI.

reviews.rationale: The packet establishes neither a validated non-neurosymbolic AGI counterexample nor a universal necessity result. Benchmark progress and narrower theoretical findings do not settle the claim. No deadline was stated, and no qualifying conclusive event is demonstrated.
